# Configuring Claude Code

Claude Code reads its user settings from `~/.claude/settings.json` and project
settings from `.claude/settings.json`. Hooks and permission rules are described
in the official documentation.

To see the current settings, open the file in an editor. Explain each key to the
user and ask before suggesting a change. Settings are never changed by this
skill.
